subject: Vendor activation hold: supplemental tax evidence and EIN snapshot
body:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Luis Moreno <l.moreno@novapharma.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: requested supplemental tax evidence for PO activation

Hi Luis,

Thanks for sending the signed W-8BEN-E earlier this week. Our finance team ran the standard verification and placed the PO on hold because the document we received doesn't include the EIN or an equivalent tax registration number that matches the company name on the vendor profile.

To move PO RDW-4489 to Active we need either:
- A clear copy of the company EIN documentation (letter from the issuing authority or an IRS/foreign tax authority equivalent), or
- A recent bank statement or tax return page that shows Nova Pharmaceutical Supplies and the EIN/tax ID, or
- A notarized declaration from an authorized signer confirming the EIN and legal entity name (if the W-8BEN-E was signed by an agent).

Please attach one of the above. If you already sent the EIN snapshot to a different inbox, can you forward it here so we can reconcile?

I'll loop in Marissa from Finance to confirm once we have the evidence.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Luis Moreno <l.moreno@novapharma.co>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: New vendor paperwork (W-8BEN-E)

Hi Stephanie,

Appreciate the quick review. Attached is the signed W-8BEN-E for Nova Pharmaceutical Supplies. Our AP team provided it. Let me know if anything else is needed.

Best,
Luis
Senior Ops Manager
Nova Pharmaceutical Supplies
[attachment: Nova_W8BEN-E_signed_20270408.pdf (pdf)]

On Fri, Apr 9, 2027 at 09:23 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
> To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

> Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: requested supplemental tax evidence for PO activation
>
> Team —
>
> Quick finance note: the W-8BEN-E we have lists the beneficiary as "Nova Pharma" while the vendor record in Coupa/our vendor master is "Nova Pharmaceutical Supplies, Inc." The EIN on the IRS-equivalent field is blank in the PDF metadata. We need something that ties the legal name to the EIN.
>
> Karthik — can you confirm whether procurement captured a DBA during the sales intake? If not, request a formal company-level document that matches the legal name.
>
> I will hold the PO until evidence is reconciled; once Marissa confirms, we'll release and issue PO RDW-4489.
>
> -Marissa
> Finance, Redwood Inference

> -----Original Message-----
> From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
> To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
> Cc: Luis Moreno <l.moreno@novapharma.co>
> Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: requested supplemental tax evidence for PO activation
>
> FYI — during the discovery calls sales captured the vendor as "Nova Pharmaceutical Supplies" (no Inc). The signed W-8 shows a shortened name in the beneficiary field. I'll request that Luis provide a formal company certificate or EIN letter and confirm the legal name for the vendor profile.
>
> Karthik
> Strategic Accounts
>
From: Luis Moreno <l.moreno@novapharma.co>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:48:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: requested supplemental tax evidence for PO activation

Good morning —

Attaching an EIN snapshot from our corporate registry and a photo of the signed letter from our accountant. The image is a cropped screenshot; if you need a certified copy we'll coordinate with our legal team.

Attachments:
- EIN_declaration_snapshot_20270410.png
- Accountant_letter_signed_20270410.pdf (attached to vendor portal)

Please confirm once you reconcile.

Regards,
Luis

[attachment: EIN_declaration_snapshot_20270410.png (image)]

> Thanks Luis — received the snapshots. Two quick items: the EIN image has a partial watermark and the legal entity line still displays the DBA. Can you get a copy of the government registry extract or a bank account statement that shows the full legal name "Nova Pharmaceutical Supplies, Inc." and the EIN in the same document? That should be sufficient for our audit trail.
>
> If there's a timing constraint on the PO, we can accept a notarized declaration as interim evidence, but we need the registry extract within 15 business days.
>
> -Marissa
>
